scope: All 95 measures of each original reader XML; anchored full payload saved in phase2_original_xml_marks_route.json and read in phase2_marks_summary.txt. Compared against print_system_01 through 17 and phase1_inventory.json.

readers.Audiveris: Original XML has much of the short-slur articulation inventory, but substitutes ties for grace-related phrasing in P001/P009/P013, drops grace glyphs, falsely adds staccatos (e.g. P001 endpoints, P018 opening), adds unprinted fingerings P009/P011/P076, a false fermata P045 and inverted-mordent P064. Reject those additions. P022 upper phrase missing. P030/P031 and P051/P052 slur starts lack corresponding local stops. P049-P050 malformed duplicated slur endpoints must instead preserve printed C4/D4/A4 ties. P034/P035 accent assigned to moving voice rather than held D5; P031/P052 accent assigned bass instead of upper phrase. Missing lower middle-section chord slurs/articulations, and P066 upper inner-voice fermata. P076 duplicated note/mark claims and chromatic signature error do not establish new voices or flat signature. P085 wrongly shifted third pair and erroneous additional slur; printed three beat groups remain distinct. P095 final and repeats match broad routing, but P066 double boundary needs retention.
readers.PlayScore: Original XML captures many pitch and duration groups, but omits grace notes P009/P013/P067/P076; invents fingerings P001/P013/P016/P032/P054/P094, tenutos and octave-shift stops. No printed octave-shift signs. False tie P005-P006 wrongly propagates Bb2; false ties P026-P027 wrongly propagate Bb4/Bb5. Missing much text (Moderato, cresc., decresc., dim.) and many accents. fz misread ff/f at P015/P016/P081/P082. P020/P021 upper repeated pair-slurs largely missing. Opening phrase P001 extends into P002 and duplicate P002 slurs; P003/P069 stop one eighth early. P022/P067/P088 opening long slur endpoint must be visually assessed independently; small grace curve separate. P011 lower rising phrase missing. P032/P053 lower latter slur has differing start; wedges incorrectly leak into next bar. P036 hairpin stop leaks into P037; P057 diminuendo missing. P044 false local slurs, P051 upper long slur curtailed to first triple, P052 starts late. P049-P050 three tie members are correctly represented. P066 inner upper fermata missing. P078 missing middle triplet B4 and spurious tenuto. P086/P087 incomplete upper pair-slurs. Broad repeats and final bar retained; P066 double boundary missing.
readers.SmartScore: Original XML injects page headings, garbled composer/title and imprint as timed words at P001-P006/P024/P026/P063; reject all as musical directions and keep metadata separately. Additional spurious f/p duplicate dynamics and P006 rit. are unsupported. Chord-member articulation duplication must not become multiple visible dots. Most grace/phrase endpoints are incomplete or confused with ties; P022/P026/P067/P088 false repeated-pitch ties cross intervening notes. Many short pair-slurs absent throughout, particularly P015/P016/P020/P021/P081/P082/P087. P032/P033/P053/P054 chord phrases incorrectly become ties. P047 repeated chords incorrectly tied. P049-P050 tie members C4/D4/A4 are supported, but pp read p. P059/P060 bass phrases read as ties crossing intervening notes. P066 missing upper inner-voice fermata; repeated bottom-chord fermata member payload should not create duplicate signs. P008 backward repeat and P038 forward repeat missing. P089 ending 1 is fabricated, absent from print. P095 final bar supported. Key cancellation missing at return corrupts subsequent F readings; frame correspondence remains ordinal.

shared_blind_spots: Grace note versus main onset; implied unprinted triplet subdivision, especially return
Small grace-curve versus long motif-phrase endpoints
No printed fingering digits, pedal signs, arpeggio signs or ornamental trills/mordents
Header/footer text is metadata, not timed directions
Accents between staves require musical ownership, not nearest staff guess
Missing printed text and exact fz dynamics
P066 third fermata and double boundary
Return differs in slur endpoints, explicit accidentals and cresc. presence; do not duplicate mechanically
provisional_questions: P007/P073 separate curves and exact chord-member endpoints
P011/P077 bass phrase start; image suggests main E3 through C4, but nearby grace curve may confuse
Conventional triplet realization where numeral omitted; preserve no numeral and flag final human check
